source_diagnosis.finding: Retaining physical assignment changes later atomic selector eligibility and grows snapshot wrong notes. Commit inference normally; test actual MIDI retention independently.

policy: Default-off offline diagnostic. Preserve inference commits and require full current/trial outcome identity. Retain only already-owned MIDI lanes through a fine-subset commit certified by uninterrupted full-window completion evidence. Require fresh same-tick certificate, original pitch, active selected unsuppressed candidate, exact full actual ownership, playable mask, no selector handoff, competing claim or capacity loss. Clear certificate each inference decision; never use actual retention as inference input.
required: saved OFF/current full scored and raw references bit-identical
current/trial full inference outcome and scored assignments bit-identical
target exact held samples increase and note-ons decrease
no false duration/onset or raw-conflict growth
stop at first regression or missing target gain

red_test.expected_failure: New completion MIDI test fails held actual mask/release/attack assertions at two fine-subset corrections while inference remains the reference.

local_validation.design_review: One scoped native review complete; no material blocker. Compilation and real replay remain GitHub checks.

stage: Review fix and run source native checks on GitHub before bounded worker dispatch
limitations: Fresh wrong completion evidence can still retain a wrong actual lane; strict per-label and false-output gates decide rejection.
Does not solve initial acquisition, candidate dropout or short-note four-string initialization.
A bounded pass permits further corpus validation only, not production promotion or live readiness.
next: Complete one native review, push fix and worker task, require source checks to pass, then dispatch the bounded screen once. Native execution only on GitHub.
